DECLARE @TargetStoreID INT = 512; DECLARE @StartDateStr VARCHAR(10) = '01-03-2026'; DECLARE @EndDateStr VARCHAR(10) = '31-03-2026';
-- Convert parameters to real dates DECLARE @S_Date DATETIME = CONVERT(DATETIME, @StartDateStr, 105); DECLARE @E_Date DATETIME = CONVERT(DATETIME, @EndDateStr, 105);
SELECT itm.id as [Item.Code], itm.name as [Item],
-- 1. OPENING BALANCE (Status before @S_Date) ISNULL(Opening.TotalIn, 0) + ISNULL(Opening.TotalSalesReturn, 0) - (ISNULL(Opening.TotalSold, 0) + ISNULL(Opening.TotalTransferredOut, 0)) as [Opening],
-- 2. MOVEMENTS DURING PERIOD ISNULL(Period.InQty, 0) as [Stock.In], ISNULL(Period.SoldQty, 0) as [Sold], ISNULL(Period.RetQty, 0) as [Sales.Return], ISNULL(Period.OutQty, 0) as [Transferred],
-- 3. FINAL REMAINING (ISNULL(Opening.TotalIn, 0) + ISNULL(Opening.TotalSalesReturn, 0) - (ISNULL(Opening.TotalSold, 0) + ISNULL(Opening.TotalTransferredOut, 0))) -- Start with Opening + ISNULL(Period.InQty, 0) + ISNULL(Period.RetQty, 0) -- Add Period Inward - (ISNULL(Period.SoldQty, 0) + ISNULL(Period.OutQty, 0)) -- Subtract Period Outward as [Remaining]
FROM items itm CROSS APPLY ( -- CALCULATE EVERYTHING BEFORE THE START DATE SELECT -- A. Total Stock In (from Purchases or Transfers-In) (SELECT SUM(stock_in) FROM stock_transaction_items WHERE item_id = itm.id AND store_id = @TargetStoreID AND CONVERT(DATETIME, date, 105) < @S_Date) as TotalIn,
-- B. Total Sold (from Agreement table) (SELECT SUM(si.sold_qty) FROM sale_items si INNER JOIN aggrements ag ON si.agreement_id = ag.id WHERE si.item_id = itm.id AND ag.store_id = @TargetStoreID AND ag.date < @S_Date) as TotalSold,
-- C. Total Sales Return (from Agreement Returns table) (SELECT SUM(ari.quantity) FROM agreement_return_items ari INNER JOIN agreement_returns ar ON ari.aggrement_return_id = ar.id WHERE ari.item_id = itm.id AND ar.store_id = @TargetStoreID AND ar.return_date < @S_Date) as TotalSalesReturn,
-- D. Total Transferred Out (Check when this store is the 'From.Store') (SELECT SUM(sti_out.stock_in) FROM stock_transaction_items sti_out INNER JOIN stock_transactions st ON sti_out.stock_transaction_id = st.id WHERE sti_out.item_id = itm.id AND st.from_store = @TargetStoreID AND CONVERT(DATETIME, st.date, 105) < @S_Date) as TotalTransferredOut ) AS Opening
CROSS APPLY ( -- CALCULATE MOVEMENTS DURING THE SELECTED PERIOD SELECT -- A. Inward (SELECT SUM(stock_in) FROM stock_transaction_items WHERE item_id = itm.id AND store_id = @TargetStoreID AND CONVERT(DATETIME, date, 105) >= @S_Date AND CONVERT(DATETIME, date, 105) <= @E_Date) as InQty,
-- B. Sold (SELECT SUM(si.sold_qty) FROM sale_items si INNER JOIN aggrements ag ON si.agreement_id = ag.id WHERE si.item_id = itm.id AND ag.store_id = @TargetStoreID AND ag.date >= @S_Date AND ag.date <= @E_Date) as SoldQty,
-- C. Returned (SELECT SUM(ari.quantity) FROM agreement_return_items ari INNER JOIN agreement_returns ar ON ari.aggrement_return_id = ar.id WHERE ari.item_id = itm.id AND ar.store_id = @TargetStoreID AND ar.return_date >= @S_Date AND ar.return_date <= @E_Date) as RetQty,
-- D. Outward (SELECT SUM(sti_out.stock_in) FROM stock_transaction_items sti_out INNER JOIN stock_transactions st ON sti_out.stock_transaction_id = st.id WHERE sti_out.item_id = itm.id AND st.from_store = @TargetStoreID AND CONVERT(DATETIME, st.date, 105) >= @S_Date AND CONVERT(DATETIME, st.date, 105) <= @E_Date) as OutQty ) AS Period
WHERE ISNULL(Opening.TotalIn, 0) > 0 OR ISNULL(Period.InQty, 0) > 0 OR ISNULL(Period.SoldQty, 0) > 0 ORDER BY itm.id ASC
